description: One durable runtime record per subject-in-workflow: the singular state (current_node + state_json + status). Binds to an IMMUTABLE CRM Workflow Version. The interpreter re-enters at current_node and commits once at each suspension boundary. Runtime data only - never seeded.

fields.label: Workflow
fields.description: Records the workflow this execution is bound to.

fields.label: Workflow Version
fields.description: Records the exact frozen version this execution runs. Pinned at start; the interpreter reads its graph, never the editable Definition.

fields.label: Subject DocType
fields.description: Identifies the doctype of the record this journey is about - half of its instance key.

fields.label: Subject Name
fields.description: Identifies the record this journey is about - the other half of its instance key.

fields.label: Current Node
fields.description: Stores the node to run next; on resume the interpreter re-enters here.

fields.label: State (JSON)
fields.description: Holds the single authoritative context every node reads and writes; a consumed signal's payload is merged here. Never indexed - promote a field to a column to query it.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Records whether the execution is Running, Parked, Done, or Failed.

fields.label: Resume At
fields.description: Records when a clock-parked execution becomes due; the timer sweep wakes it at or after this.

fields.label: Awaiting Signal
fields.description: Records the signal name a parked execution waits for; a matching delivery wakes it.

fields.label: Awaiting Correlation
fields.description: Records the per-iteration token a wait matches a signal on, so a reused signal name cannot wake the wrong loop iteration.

fields.label: Retry Count
fields.description: Counts transient-failure retries, so a repeatedly deadlocking execution eventually fails instead of retrying forever.

fields.label: Active Key
fields.description: Holds a uniqueness key while live and NULL once terminal, so the database itself rejects a second live Instance for the same subject and workflow.

name: CRM Workflow Instance
